products.title: Everyday Cotton Tee
products.description: The tee you reach for every morning. Soft combed cotton, a regular fit that sits right at the hip, and a collar that keeps its shape wash after wash.

products.title: Heavyweight Boxy Tee
products.description: A dense 260 gsm cotton with a boxy cut, dropped shoulders and a slightly cropped length. Structured enough to wear on its own.

products.title: Saigon Skyline Graphic Tee
products.description: A line drawing of the Saigon skyline, printed with soft water-based ink that won't crack. Regular unisex fit.

products.title: Linen Blend Shirt
products.description: Made for humid afternoons. A breathable linen-cotton blend, relaxed fit, coconut-shell buttons and a curved hem that works tucked or untucked.

products.title: Classic Pique Polo
products.description: A clean two-button polo in textured cotton pique. Ribbed collar and cuffs, side vents, and a fit that is smart without being tight.

products.title: Oversized Fleece Hoodie
products.description: Brushed fleece inside, a roomy oversized fit, a double-layer hood and a kangaroo pocket. For air-conditioned offices and cool Da Lat nights.

products.title: Women's Fitted Crop Tee
products.description: A fitted crop tee with a little stretch. High-waist friendly length and a narrow ribbed crew neck.

products.title: Women's Relaxed V-Neck
products.description: A soft, drapey v-neck in a modal-cotton blend that feels cool against the skin. Relaxed through the body with a slightly longer back hem.

products.title: Women's Oversized Poplin Shirt
products.description: Crisp cotton poplin in an oversized cut. Wear it buttoned up, open over a tee, or knotted at the waist.

products.title: Kids Basic Tee
products.description: Organic cotton tees for kids who never sit still. Tag-free neck label and a roomy fit that leaves space to grow.
